Cost projection: at $0.1881/hr for the expected 6-12h productive compute the total is $1.13-$2.26; the 60-gen ceiling worst case is ~10h at ~600s/gen (48 cores ~75% as fast as t0115's 64-core EPYC 7713P at 160s/gen) for ~$1.88 productive + $0.50 buffer + $0.009 wasted on first attempt = ~$2.39 worst case. Alternatives explicitly rejected (from the re-query snapshot): id=37510135 EPYC 7532 32-Core Quebec $0.2121 (Zen-2 Rome, 13% more expensive than 7K62 for 1/1.5 cores effective); id=27157455 EPYC 7D12 32-Core Quebec $0.2281 (Zen-2 Rome 'D' suffix dense-cloud SKU, 21% more expensive); id=33911873 EPYC 7502 32-Core Belgium $0.2676 (Zen-2 Rome, 42% more expensive); id=37537429 EPYC 7B13 64-Core Quebec $0.4014 (Zen-3 Milan but exceeds 0.40 dph ceiling and reliability 0.9911 below 0.99 floor); id=36997329 EPYC 7B13 64-Core Quebec $0.3347 (Zen-3 Milan plan-preferred but 78% more expensive than 7K62 -- the 48 effective cores on the 7K62 vs 32 on this bundle make 7K62 the better $/core deal). The 48 effective cores (vs t0115's 64) is moderately sub-optimal for parallel evaluation but acceptable: N_EVAL_SEEDS=3 means 96*3=288 evals/gen which 48 cores can sweep in 6 batches of 48 (vs t0115's 5 batches of 64). Expected wall-clock per gen: ~240 s on 48 cores vs ~160 s on 64 cores; with the 60-gen ceiling this is ~4 hours vs t0115's 9h actual run. The Virginia location adds ~80-100 ms RTT to UK (acceptable for batch workload). For a single 6-12h run at reliability 0.9972 the failure probability is ~1.7%-3.4%, acceptable.

mod_compile.note_on_load_mechanisms: Modern NEURON places libnrnmech.so directly in x86_64/ (not in x86_64/.libs/ as older versions did). 'load_mechanisms(x86_64)' from Python returns False because it looks for the legacy path, but hasattr(h, 'bkt80') etc. all return True because NEURON auto-loads x86_64/libnrnmech.so from CWD on import. This matches t0112's, t0113's, t0114's, and t0115's observation exactly. Library size 118704 bytes is byte-identical to t0114's and t0115's library size (same Linux ABI, same Zen-class AMD64 target, same NEURON 8.2.7 build).
